_comment: Drives the status bar, ticker item 1, the WHY IT MATTERS phrase and the 2026 row in MY NUMBERS on index.html. Allowed values: "Off" | "Status lost" | "Status kept". Edit this one value to flip the page; no code change needed. Append ?elim=lost or ?elim=kept to any URL to preview a state without editing. The Speak4 email copy has its own elimination line and must be updated separately in the Speak4 dashboard.
